48.original: At the Battle of Carteneau, as fire rained down from the heavens...

49.original: Archon Louisoix invoked the power of the Keeper and sent his fellow heroes into an aetherial rift, beyond the reach of the devastation.

50.original: Five years since that fateful day, since the Seventh Umbral Era changed the world forever, the time is come for the heroes to return.

51.original: The Black Shroud─the ancient forest close to the heart of Eorzea.

52.original: Beneath the boughs of its towering trees lies the woodland city<hex:021F0103>state of Gridania.

53.original: Once a sanctuary from the world beyond the Hedge, even the mighty elementals, eternal<hex:02100103>guardians of the forest, could not forestall the coming of the Seventh Umbral Era.

54.original: However, the goddess Nophica was never one to forsake<hex:02100103>Her children, and today She welcomes another brave soul...

55.original: ...One who shall fight once more to safeguard the future of the realm.

56.original: May the Matron take <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> to Her Bosom,<hex:02100103>that <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> may never want.

57.original: And in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> heart sow serenity, purity, and sanctity.
